metadata.description: Video- and audio-making skills for Claude Opus 5.5 in Claude Code: every frame, every note and every sound generated in code, one skill per medium and style.

plugins.name: painted-animation
plugins.description: Hand-painted watercolour-and-ink cartoons and lyric videos: p5.js + p5.brush, rendered frame by frame in headless Chrome, with storyboarding, character acting, beat sync and karaoke.

plugins.name: kinetic-reel
plugins.description: Kinetic-typography motion reels: bold condensed type, HUD micro-type, three.js generative layers, shape-continuity transitions and a synthesized beat-locked score.

plugins.name: podcast-studio
plugins.description: Complete podcast episodes from a Markdown script: line-per-turn scripts with stable clip ids, per-line speech, chapter beats, a generated sting and music bed, a mastered WAV plus chapter-marked MP3, cover art and a review player.
